import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { captain, s04Fixture } from '../test/supervision-s04-fixture';
import { activationEffects } from '../server/supervisor-sessions';
import { SupervisionEvents } from '../server/supervision-events';
import { SupervisionInbox } from '../server/supervision-inbox';
import { SupervisionLifecycle } from '../server/supervision-lifecycle';

const profile = { provider: 'codex/gpt-6.1-sol', modeId: 'full-access', thinkingOptionId: 'high' };
async function integrated() {
  const f = await s04Fixture(), ingress = new SupervisionEvents(f.store), inbox = new SupervisionInbox(f.store, { offers: true });
  const lifecycle = new SupervisionLifecycle(f.store, ingress, inbox, f.sessions, f.gateway, { enabled: true });
  async function owner(n: number) {
    const scope = await f.addScope(n, `goal-${n}`, [`work-${n}`], false);
    await f.sessions.prepare({ requestId: randomUUID(), scopeId: scope.id, scopeVersion: 1, profile, opening: 'Read the exact scope checkpoint.' }, captain);
    const binding = await activate(scope.id, 1);
    await f.draft(scope, [{id: `work-${n}`}], true);
    return { scope, binding };
  }
  async function activate(scopeId: string, epoch: number) {
    const effects = activationEffects(await f.store.read(), scopeId, epoch);
    await f.gateway.dispatch(effects.workspace!.id); await f.gateway.dispatch(effects.create!.id);
    const binding = await f.sessions.verify(scopeId, epoch);
    await f.gateway.dispatch(effects.send!.id); f.receiver.finish(binding.agentId);
    return binding;
  }
  return { ...f, ingress, inbox, lifecycle, owner, activate };
}

describe('R04 independent recovery composition', {timeout: 60000}, () => {
  it('manual replacement must reoffer the old owner pending page before new facts can progress', async () => {
    const f = await integrated(), {scope, binding} = await f.owner(1);
    const launched = await f.launch(scope, 'work-1');
    const worker = (await f.store.read()).attempts.find(a => a.id === launched.attemptId)!.worker!;
    await f.ingress.permission(worker.agentId, 'permission-old-owner');
    const original = await f.lifecycle.wake(scope.id, 'event');
    expect(original.state).toBe('accepted');
    await f.sessions.hold({requestId: randomUUID(), scopeId: scope.id, expectedEpoch: 1, reason: 'Explicit fixture replacement.'}, captain);
    f.receiver.agents.get(binding.agentId)!.status = 'closed';
    await f.sessions.prepareReplacement({requestId: randomUUID(), scopeId: scope.id,
      scopeVersion: (await f.store.read()).scopes.find(s => s.id === scope.id)!.version,
      expectedEpoch: 1, profile, opening: 'Resume the existing pending checkpoint.'}, captain);
    const replacement = await f.activate(scope.id, 2);
    await f.ingress.permission(worker.agentId, 'permission-new-owner');
    let refusal: unknown = null;
    try { await f.lifecycle.wake(scope.id, 'restart'); } catch(e) { refusal = {code: (e as any).code, message: (e as Error).message}; }
    const before = await f.store.read();
    // Positive control: the existing S02 operation repairs the missing composition without a new worker.
    await f.inbox.reoffer(scope.id, 2);
    const repaired = await f.lifecycle.wake(scope.id, 'event');
    const after = await f.store.read();
    await writeFile(join(process.env.R04_EVIDENCE!, 'replacement-page.json'), JSON.stringify({
      original, refusal, beforeOffers: before.inbox.offers, beforeAssignments: before.inbox.assignments,
      repaired, afterOffers: after.inbox.offers, replacement: replacement.agentId
    }, null, 2));
    expect(repaired.state).toBe('accepted');
    expect(f.receiver.sends.at(-1)!.agentId).toBe(replacement.agentId);
    expect(refusal).toBeNull();
  });

  it('one slow worker observation during recovery must not block a different ready owner wake', async () => {
    const f = await integrated(), a = await f.owner(1), b = await f.owner(2);
    const launched = await f.launch(a.scope, 'work-1');
    const worker = (await f.store.read()).attempts.find(x => x.id === launched.attemptId)!.worker!;
    let release!: () => void, entered!: () => void;
    const barrier = new Promise<void>(resolve => { release = resolve; });
    const atLookup = new Promise<void>(resolve => { entered = resolve; });
    const originalFind = f.receiver.findAgent.bind(f.receiver);
    f.receiver.findAgent = async id => { if (id === worker.agentId) { entered(); await barrier; } return originalFind(id); };
    const before = f.receiver.sends.length, recovering = f.lifecycle.recover('restart');
    let progressedBeforeRelease = false;
    try {
      await atLookup;
      // Only the controlled A lookup is blocked. B is idle and has a ready plan.
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 500));
      progressedBeforeRelease = f.receiver.sends.slice(before).some(s => s.agentId === b.binding.agentId);
    } finally { release(); }
    await recovering;
    const progressedAfterRelease = f.receiver.sends.slice(before).some(s => s.agentId === b.binding.agentId);
    await writeFile(join(process.env.R04_EVIDENCE!, 'recovery-independence.json'), JSON.stringify({progressedBeforeRelease, progressedAfterRelease}, null, 2));
    expect(progressedAfterRelease).toBe(true);
    expect(progressedBeforeRelease).toBe(true);
  });
});
